digest.component_or_area: plan-review orchestrator / context assembly / hierarchy loading
propositions: list_tickets and per-child show_ticket failures in _assemble_context_uncached are caught by bare except Exception, silently leaving children empty without recording incompleteness

empty children list causes PlanContext.has_children to return False, which suppresses container-scoped checks like p5_task_dag and p8_reviewability container pairing, producing a silent PASS instead of an incompleteness signal

finalize_verdict computes verdict only from coverage dict flags (llm_unavailable, verify_failed), not from PlanContext attributes, so hierarchy_incomplete must be threaded through coverage at all five call sites

plan_review_coach receives no real PlanContext (its pctx is a minimal reconstruction); it must source hierarchy_incomplete/hierarchy_incomplete_detail from ctx.inputs populated by precheck's step output, requiring YAML edits to all four plan_review_coach step invocations in plan-review.yaml
drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop must also check coverage.get(hierarchy_incomplete) to prevent a dropped BLOCK from reverting an INDETERMINATE verdict back to PASS

parent epic AC #4 forbids clean PASS on incomplete hierarchy; no relevance carve-out is implementable because failed enumeration collapses children to empty, which unconditionally suppresses the container-specific criteria that would need the hierarchy, making relevance detection structurally impossible
